## exhibitions

 

[Until 7 Feb 2027 Harder Better Faster Stronger Are Men OK? Four young East Asian men stand in profile in a row in a bright room. They are posing with their athletic bodies, wearing only shorts and socks. One man wears a white cap and another has a tattoo on his arm. They look to the left, and the last man is holding a wire.](/en/exhibitions/harder-better-faster-stronger)

[Until 9 May 2027 Diana Markosian Father Work from Diana Markosian’s series Father, 2014–2025 © Diana Markosian, depicting a mother with a small child and the silhouette of a father who has been removed from the photograph.](/en/exhibitions/diana-markosian-father)

[New Until 31 Dec 2026 Donald Boström Life is But a Day Photograph by Donald Boström. Three children sit on a pink sofa in a field of debris after a disaster. Around them lie rusty metal sheets, wood, clothes and bottles. Behind them stands a wrecked wooden house without walls under a cloudy sky.](/en/exhibitions/donald-bostrom)

[Until 29 Nov 2026 Lotta Antonsson I Am Everything Black-and-white close-up of a woman’s face where small seashells have been placed on the image—two over the eyes and several along the lips like teeth. The combination of a printed/drawn image and real objects creates a playful, surreal effect.](/en/exhibitions/lotta-antonsson)

[Until 7 Feb 2027 Nils Petter Löfstedt The Unmeasurable – the photos A close-up black-and-white portrait of a middle-aged man with short hair. Captured from a front angle, the image focuses closely on his facial features as he gazes upwards into the light with a thoughtful and solemn expression.](/en/exhibitions/nils-petter-lofstedt)

[Until 29 Nov 2026 The Machine's Eye in Human Hands White cockatoo with a black beak attached to a technical apparatus with transparent tubes, wires, and orange hoses against a black background.](/en/exhibitions/the-machines-eye-in-human-hands)

[Upcoming exhibition From 5 Dec 2026 Women Behind the Camera, 1848–1968 Group Exhibition Black-and-white studio portrait from the early 1900s. A woman in a dark suit and a large flower-trimmed hat holds a parrot on her hand. In front of her, a long-haired dog sits on an ornate chair with floral upholstery.](/en/exhibitions/women-behind-the-camera-1848-1968)

### Events

Events at Fotografiska are an expression of our commitment to local culture, and bringing to life the exhibitions of our artists. From live music and performance, to intimate discussions and dinner – our programming invites the community to gather, discuss, share and celebrate photography.

[See all events](https://stockholm.fotografiska.com/en/events)

### gift card

Surprise your loved ones with a piece of Fotografiska, from museum admission to curated books, posters and other items from our museum store. You can also gift a membership to unlock the full Fotografiska experience.

[buy a gift card](/en/gift-card)

[gift card](/en/gift-card)

### Store

Explore the Fotografiska store! Discover our poster reproductions of contemporary and past exhibition favorites, and browse our selection of design and gifts.

[Poster for the exhibition "I Am Everything" by Lotta Antonsson at Fotografiska. Black-and-white photo of a nude woman lying in bed, hair spread across the pillow, a seashell covering her eyes. Discover our posters Featuring works by world-renowned photographers. Each piece is printed on premium matte 170g paper.](https://shop.fotografiska.com/collections/posters) [Rounded ceramic vase in dark brown with white circular glaze spots across the surface. The vase has a wide, curved body and a narrow, irregular mouth opening. home décor Explore decor, tech essentials, and lifestyle accessories to inspire your home.](https://shop.fotografiska.com/collections/home-objects) [Book cover for "Ren Hang" by Dian Hanson, published by Taschen. Red cover with a star-shaped cutout revealing a photograph of a face with tongue out, an arm raised overhead against a cloudy sky. For Photography Enthusiasts For those who see the world through a lens. From posters to photography books, accessories & more.](https://shop.fotografiska.com/collections/for-photographers) [Pile of posters rolled up on the floor Store Visit us in‑store to discover an even wider selection of products and inspiring exhibitions.](https://shop.fotografiska.com/collections/stockholm-museum?view=stockholm-landing-page)

### Membership

Welcome to the Fotografiska Family! Enjoy unlimited access to our exhibitions and venues, as well as exclusive openings and other events.

[EXPLORE OUR MEMBERSHIPS](/en/membership)

### Dine and Drink

Fotografiska’s award-winning restaurants always serve good and well-prepared seasonal food. Always enjoyable. Always sustainable.

[A close-up of a group of women dressed in red, toasting with cocktail glasses in a festive atmosphere.
